steps.title: Apply to post
steps.body: Submit your work email and company details. No free email accounts — your domain must match your business.

steps.title: Get approved
steps.body: Our team verifies your business registration, hiring contact, and company legitimacy within one business day.

steps.title: Post and connect
steps.body: Reach a focused pool of verified people with disabilities. Every member has been manually reviewed.

whoYoullMeet.headline: Talent most hiring processes
whoYoullMeet.body: Every member on NORVARDEN is a real person with a verified account. Disability is self-identified and never required: you meet candidates by their skills, experience and goals.

profiles.label: Experienced professionals
profiles.body: Engineers, analysts, designers, operators and leaders who bring deep experience and creative problem-solving to every role.

profiles.label: Students & early career
profiles.body: Graduates and interns ready to grow, looking for employers who invest in mentorship and accommodations.

profiles.label: Career changers
profiles.body: People moving into new fields after an injury, diagnosis or life change, with transferable skills and fresh perspective.

veteranHiring.headline: SkillBridge and beyond.
veteranHiring.body: NORVARDEN is a SkillBridge-friendly platform. Companies approved as SkillBridge partners can post internship opportunities for transitioning service members. We flag your company profile so veterans know you're ready to hire them.

points.text: Your profile is flagged as a SkillBridge partner
Reach transitioning service members actively seeking civilian roles

items.question: How does company verification work?
items.answer: We confirm your work email domain matches your company website, look up your business registration or nonprofit status, and verify that the hiring contact is a real employee. Most verifications complete within one business day.

items.question: What happens if we don't pass verification?
items.answer: We'll tell you exactly what's missing and give you a chance to provide additional documentation. We don't reject companies without explanation.

closingBand.headline: Your next win starts
closingBand.body: Join the companies already hiring verified people with disabilities.
